items.title: Microsoft 365 email, Teams and Outlook are back after an outage of more than a day
items.why: A failed network capacity upgrade knocked out Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams and Copilot for businesses worldwide from Thursday afternoon. Microsoft says service was restored early Saturday and that it was not a cyberattack.
items.action: Write down a backup plan for the next email outage: a phone or chat fallback, an offline staff contact list, and who tells customers.

items.title: Police take down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC malware servers, seize 6.4M logins
items.why: Operation Endgame seized or disrupted about 235 servers used to spread password-stealing and ransomware-linked malware. The stolen logins were shared with Have I Been Pwned and other notification services.
items.action: Check your business email domain on Have I Been Pwned and reset passwords, with MFA turned on, for any accounts that appear.

items.title: Public 'SignDrop' exploit lets a standard Windows user take full control; no patch yet
items.why: A researcher released code abusing the Windows log file driver to reach SYSTEM on Windows 11 and Server 2025. Microsoft has not issued a fix, and no attacks have been reported so far.
items.action: Keep Windows CLFS protection switched on (do not set it to mode 2 or 3), limit who can log in to servers, and install Microsoft's fix when it ships.

items.title: Citrix fixes nine critical NetScaler ADC and Gateway flaws plus a Console login bypass
items.why: The patches cover memory flaws in NetScaler ADC and Gateway and a 9.4-rated NetScaler Console bug that lets attackers reach restricted areas without a login. No attacks are reported yet, but NetScaler is a frequent target.
items.action: Update NetScaler ADC and Gateway to 14.1-73.57 or 13.1-64.39 or later, and NetScaler Console to 14.1-74.34 or later.

items.title: Notion AI chat transcripts stolen through a breach at its AI provider Fireworks
items.why: Attackers got into Fireworks AI through its cloud provider and took billing data and datasets. Notion says about 1% of its customers had Notion AI transcripts taken before it cut ties on November 3.
items.action: List the AI services your tools send company data to, and ask each vendor which of their own providers can see it.

items.title: Apache web server update fixes a critical HTTP/2 flaw that could allow remote takeover
items.why: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.55 through 2.4.70 with HTTP/2 turned on can be crashed and possibly taken over without a login. Version 2.4.71 fixes it; no attacks are reported yet.
items.action: Ask your web host or IT provider to update Apache to 2.4.71, or turn off HTTP/2 until the update is installed.
